opennyai_summary.facts:
1.  By the present writ petition, the petitioner seeks for  withdrawal/quashing of the order of suspension issued  by the respondent no.4, the Chairman, District Primary School Council, Purba Bardhaman dated 7th April, 2025 (annexure P3).
2. The petitioner joined as an Assistant Teacher on 22nd February, 2021 at Babuishole F.P. School and was thereafter transferred to Argon F.P. School in the year 2024.
On 7th April, 2024, a criminal case being Burwan P.S. Case No.171 of 2024 dated 7th April, 2024 was initiated against the petitioner under Sections 498A/325/307 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act (G.R. Case No.834 of 2024) at the instance of his wife.
The petitioner was arrested on 17th October, 2024 and was released from jail custody on 30th October, 2024.
Thereafter, the petitioner resumed his duties.
All on a sudden on 7th April, 2025 the impugned order of suspension has been passed by the Chairman, District Primary School Council, Purba Bardhaman, respondent no.4, against the petitioner.
On 21st May, 2025, the petitioner has made a representation praying for withdrawal of such suspension order.
However, no steps have been taken.
Hence, this writ petition.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Purba Bardhaman is directed to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 21st May, 2025 in accordance with law upon notice to the petitioner by passing a reasoned order within a period of six weeks from the date of communication of this order.
6. The reasoned order shall be communicated to the petitioner within a week of passing of such order.
7. Learned advocate for the petitioner is directed to communicate this order to the respondent No.4,
District Primary School Council, Purba Bardhaman, for necessary compliance.
8. With the above direction, the writ petition being WPA 15305 of 2025 stands disposed of.
9. Since no affidavits have been called for, the allegation made in the writ petition is deemed to be not admitted.
10. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
11. All connected applications, if any, stand disposed of.
12. There shall be no order as to costs.
13. All concerned parties shall act in terms of the copy of the order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
14. Urgent Photostat certified copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of all necessary legal formalities.
